facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.justification: MOC-2024-0011 was raised at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility on 2 February 2024 following 3 recorded events in the archive, including CAPA-2005-003, CAPA-2008-003 and INC-2024-003. The change assurance record covers 3 clauses across 2 controlled documents. The intent is to restate an existing duty without altering what it requires. The record reached the state abandoned in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the material unwanted event control set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are PRO-HSE-005 and STD-HTW-004.
